milestone.amount: The agreed monetary value for this phase in the contract. It is what the client pays into escrow for this milestone and what informs payout once approvals complete.
milestone.order: The sequence number of this phase in the project. Lower numbers are usually worked earlier; it keeps phases ordered for planning and billing.
milestone.statusVsPayment: Work status reflects approvals and execution (for example in progress or approved). Payment status reflects escrow funding steps derived from that workflow—for example pending payment after supervisor approval—not a separate manual switch.

payment.bank_name: Enter the bank name as shown on your transfer receipt so operations can match your payment.
payment.transaction_reference: Enter the unique reference, confirmation number, or transaction ID from your transfer so we can reconcile the deposit.
payment.receipt_image: Upload a clear JPEG or PNG (maximum 5 MB) of your transfer confirmation.
payment.notes: Optional notes for finance—for example when you sent the transfer or which account it came from.
